newsitem.title: USA: Chevron signs exploration pact with Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Chevron signs exploration pact with Colombia.

text.p: Chevron Corp said on Tuesday it signed a exploration pact with Empresa Colombiana de Petroleos (Ecopetrol), the state oil company of Colombia, to explore more than 166,000 acres near Bogota.

Located 70 miles east-northeast of the capital city, the area of exploration, known as the Galeron block, lies adjacent to the giant Cusiana oilfield and on trend with new crude oil and gas discoveries at Florena, Pauto Sur, and Volcanera.
Chevron will hold a 100 percent interest in the 67,422-hectare Galeron block during the pact's exploration phase.
Seismic exploration will begin in early 1997, but drilling plans remain undetermined.
